caveats: Synthetic in-process application hotpaths, not an HTTP or production capacity guarantee
No real RPC network, cryptographic presence verification, inference, signing or transactions
Qualification records are preverified synthetic fixtures with identity bindings but no full signed response archives; their memory is a lower bound
Admission limits remain enforced; offered cohorts may contain unqualified providers
5s poll and25s presence are explicit configurable load assumptions
Historical objects are distinct; fixture generation and reload are excluded from active latency but included in process maxRSS
Cases stop at a wall-time deadline; unstarted events and aborts report overload rather than being silently dropped
Filesystem timings describe this temporary filesystem and cannot be extrapolated to a VPS disk
